output.patientMessage: A Counsel clinician can review your physical therapy referral request in this thread; no urgent in-person visit is needed for long-standing back ache without new injury or nerve symptoms. Staying active in the meantime usually helps. Seek emergency care right away if you develop new leg weakness, numbness in the groin or buttocks, or trouble controlling your bladder or bowels.
